title: Granular Scopes for Video Ratings
summary: The videos.getRating method now supports the youtube.readonly scope, allowing for more restricted access to rating data.
details: The OAuth 2.0 scope requirements for the `videos.getRating` method have been updated. Specifically, `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly` has been added as a valid scope. While `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtubepartner` remains available, developers can now follow the principle of least privilege by using the read-only scope for applications that only need to check video ratings without requiring full partner permissions.
